rationale: Resolves the $18.3k cash deficit by repairing the inverted land expansion condition in Capital Reinvestment (triggering when uncultivated_plots <= 2) to scale contiguous plots up to 24 for 10 hands, while embedding fertilizer application directly into routine Farm Execution dispatch to boost harvest yields. Extends Town Shop deliveries through Day 30 to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract premiums on late-maturing crops while cutting off non-maturing seed purchases after Day 25-26, and frees the Wheat feed reserve when zero livestock are present.
